import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the provided CSV and group temperatures by city.
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/weather.csv')
cities = sorted(df['city'].dropna().unique())
data = [df.loc[df['city'] == city, 'temp_c'].dropna() for city in cities]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 5))
ax.boxplot(data, tick_labels=cities)
ax.set_xlabel('City')
ax.set_ylabel('Temperature (°C)')
ax.set_title('Temperature by City')
ax.set_ylim(bottom=0)
ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.25)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
